newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 15 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 15 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Denver Board of Water, Colo., $16.975 million GO refunding bonds.
--Eveleth-Gilbert Independent School District, Minn., $1.49 million GOs.
--Los Lunas School District No 1, N.M., $2.5 million GOs.
--Lyme Central School District, N.Y., $1.595 million school bonds.
--Southern Cayuga Central School District, N.Y., $4.21 million school bonds.
--Chester County School District, S.C., $19 million GOs.
--Lexington County School District No 5, S.C., $22 million GOs.
